item.title: 55-plus apartment complex near Venice up for sale
item.description: A newly built apartment complex for adults ages 55 and up has been put on the market near Venice. Solea Wellen Park, which was completed in 2025, was listed by JBM Institutional Multifamily Advisors.On 9.15 acres on West Villages Parkway, the property includes 204 apartments in four-story buildings equipped with elevators. item.title: Clearwater deck company expands to Minnesota
item.description: Decks & Docks, a Clearwater-based distributor of composite decking and outdoor living supplies, has expanded into Minnesota with the purchase of Minneapolis-based Pro Deck Supply, the company announced Monday. Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed. Founded in 2014, Pro Deck Supply offers framing, decking, railing and deck accessories to both professional contractors and DIY homeowners, according to a release. item.title: Sarasota family office acquires Ohio plastics manufacturer
item.description: A Sarasota family office has acquired a plastics manufacturing company based in Ada, Ohio. Nickolas Asset Management purchased Associated Plastics Corp. and plans to upgrade the systems in place at the 150,000-square-foot manufacturing and warehouse campus. Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.Included in the acquisition were the Associated Plastics Corp. campus, molding and production equipment and infrastructure to operate the large-scale manufacturing facility. item.title: Sarasota-based truck driving program expands nationally
item.description: A Sarasota-based company that provides CDL training for aspiring truck drivers is growing its footprint on college campuses and expanding its model to partner with private employers. FleetForce Truck Driver Training Program, headquartered on Tuttle Avenue, currently offers its services in two states; it has 13 locations, including 11 in Florida and two in Texas. item.title: Lee Health clinic in Babcock Ranch grows
item.description: A primary care clinic has grown in size and capacity in Babcock Ranch. The Lee Health Family Medicine clinic at 42880 Crescent Loop opened its newly expanded facility, which now includes an on-site lab, on Tuesday.The clinic has increased its primary care bandwidth, growing to eight primary care exam rooms.
